name: Paneer Butter Masala
recipe_steps: Simmer paneer in a spiced tomato, butter and cream sauce until tender.

name: Dal Tadka
recipe_steps: Cook lentils until soft, then finish with a hot garlic, cumin and tomato tempering.

name: Chole Bhature
recipe_steps: Simmer chickpeas with onion, tomato and spices; serve with bhature or a lighter bread.

name: Fish Curry
recipe_steps: Gently simmer fish in a coconut, tamarind and chilli sauce until just cooked.

name: Butter Chicken
recipe_steps: Cook chicken in a tomato, butter and cream sauce with garam masala.

name: Green Curry
recipe_steps: Simmer chicken, eggplant and green curry paste in coconut milk; finish with basil.

name: Palak Paneer
recipe_steps: Cook spinach with garlic and spices, blend smooth, then simmer with paneer.

name: Aloo Gobi
recipe_steps: Sauté potato and cauliflower with turmeric, cumin, tomato and ginger until tender.

name: Rajma Masala
recipe_steps: Simmer kidney beans in a tomato-onion masala until thick and soft.

name: Kadai Paneer
recipe_steps: Sauté paneer and peppers with crushed coriander, tomato and kadai spices.

name: Kerala Egg Curry
recipe_steps: Simmer boiled eggs in a coconut milk curry with onion, tomato and curry leaves.

name: Chicken Chettinad
recipe_steps: Toast pepper and fennel, grind with spices, then simmer with chicken and coconut.

name: Vegetable Korma
recipe_steps: Simmer mixed vegetables in a mild coconut and cashew sauce until tender.

name: Tandoori Chicken
recipe_steps: Marinate chicken in yogurt, lemon and spices, then roast or grill until cooked through.

name: Lemon Rice
recipe_steps: Toss cooked rice with lemon, turmeric and a quick mustard-seed tempering.

name: Vegetable Upma
recipe_steps: Toast semolina, then simmer with sautéed vegetables and seasoned water.

name: Vegetable Pulao
recipe_steps: Cook basmati rice with vegetables and whole spices until fluffy.

name: Pesarattu
recipe_steps: Blend soaked mung beans with ginger, spread thinly and pan-cook with onion.

name: Sambar Rice
recipe_steps: Cook rice and lentils with vegetables, tamarind and sambar spices until soft.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala
recipe_steps: Grill spiced chicken pieces, then simmer them in a tomato and cream masala.

name: Kadhi Pakora
recipe_steps: Simmer a yogurt and gram-flour curry, add onion fritters and cook until tender.

name: Masoor Dal
recipe_steps: Simmer red lentils with tomato and turmeric, then season with cumin and garlic.

name: Pesto Penne
recipe_steps: Toss cooked penne with basil pesto, parmesan and a splash of pasta water.

name: Mushroom Risotto
recipe_steps: Add warm stock gradually to toasted rice; stir in mushrooms and parmesan.

name: Minestrone Soup
recipe_steps: Simmer beans, vegetables and pasta in tomato broth until the pasta is tender.

name: Vegetable Enchiladas
recipe_steps: Fill tortillas with beans and vegetables, cover with salsa and bake until bubbling.

name: Chicken Fajitas
recipe_steps: Sear seasoned chicken and peppers; finish with lime and serve with warm tortillas.

name: Black Bean Tostadas
recipe_steps: Layer seasoned black beans, avocado, tomato and lettuce on crisp tostadas.

name: Tofu Red Curry
ingredients: tofu;red curry paste;coconut milk;bamboo shoots;bell pepper
recipe_steps: Simmer tofu and vegetables in red curry paste and coconut milk until tender.

name: Chicken Satay
recipe_steps: Marinate chicken strips, grill until cooked and serve with a lime-peanut sauce.

name: Pad See Ew
recipe_steps: Stir-fry wide rice noodles with chicken, egg, greens and a savoury soy sauce.

name: Teriyaki Tofu Bowl
recipe_steps: Pan-sear tofu, glaze with ginger-soy teriyaki and serve with rice and broccoli.

name: Bibimbap
recipe_steps: Arrange seasoned vegetables over rice, top with egg and serve with gochujang.

name: Shakshuka
recipe_steps: Simmer peppers and tomatoes with paprika, then poach eggs in the sauce.

name: Mujaddara
recipe_steps: Cook rice and lentils together; top with deeply caramelized onions.

name: Ratatouille
recipe_steps: Layer sliced vegetables with tomato, garlic and herbs; bake until soft.

name: Three-Bean Veggie Chili
recipe_steps: Simmer three beans with tomato, corn and chilli until thick.

name: BBQ Chicken Bowl
recipe_steps: Grill chicken with barbecue sauce and serve over rice with corn and slaw.
